text.p: Following are the main stories in Friday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
All dailies lead with Singapore Senior Minister Lee Kuan Yew's apology for his remarks on Malaysia's southern Johor state earlier in the week.
-- Malaysia is going to allow local bus operators to import more buses in order to relieve the country's worsening traffic congestion problems.
-- Malaysia qualified for the hockey World Cup Finals in Holland next year when it beat Belgium 3-0 in Kuala Lumpur on Thursday.
-- The Multimedia Development Corporation is finalising proposals from 12 companies interested in carrying out research and development activities in the Multimedia Super Corridoor.
-- The 200,000 Malaysian workers in Singapore are being urged to return home if they feel the Singapore government is not appreciating their efforts.
